_comment: WO-4 done-criterion (2026-10-05 build brief; ADR 0020 and its 2026-10-05 amendment):
a pilot of cell 0b completes on CPU. Cell 0b is v1's shape -- hidden 64, 2 blocks,
2 heads, feed-forward 256, dropout 0.2, history 50, 512 examples per optimizer step,
Adam 1e-3 -- with the sampled softmax at 1,024 uniform negatives (the vectorized
sampler) and ADR 0020's early stopping: a seeded 1% of training users each give up
their last training example as the probe; recall@500 on it after every pass; stop
once it improves by less than 0.5% relative; 3 to 5 passes. The 28-day holdout
plays no part in stopping. Objective of record strict-prefix-final-position-v1;
WO-3's outcome may change the objective WO-5 trains on. Seed 42, exact search, CPU.
This is also the CPU half of the paired device pilot (wo4-cell0b-mps-pilot-6pct.json).
A pilot checks correctness and direction, never a result (about 108 warm users).
No warm-recall threshold is predeclared; for direction, WO-1's four reference pilots
checks: the protocol hash below equals the run's before any number is read; cold
recall@500 equals the WO-1 references' 0.5427033422 exactly (cold users are
popularity-routed; a difference is a defect); the probe's latest timestamp is below
the cutoff; the run fits inside twice its projected time.

projection.measured: 2026-10-05, 60 optimizer steps of this cell on the O-25 6% partition, steady-state steps 11-60, one thread, load average about 3.9 with two other 6% pilots running
projection.basis: 3 to 5 passes at the measured step time, plus data load and per-pass probe and holdout scoring

result.concurrent: WO-2 pilots s13 and s21 during passes 1-2
